name: Default
shortDescription: Multi-model AI chat workspace with personas, Beam multi-model answers, voice, image generation and support for most hosted and local LLM providers.

alerts.message: big-AGI has no built-in login: anyone with the URL can use the instance. Each user adds their own model provider API key in the app settings; only set server-side keys such as OPENAI_API_KEY if you put authentication in front of the app.
